summary: Launch Africa Ventures is a pan-African fund addressing the funding gap between seed and pre-Series A. Its FAQ states a focus on pre-seed, seed, pre-Series A and Series A investments in companies whose core operations and teams are located in Africa. The site lists two seed fund portfolios and a pitch form, and publishes an info email. Check size, sector focus and a street address are not stated.

investmentEvidence.company: Seed Fund I and II portfolios
investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage links portfolio pages for two seed funds; individual companies and dates are not listed on the homepage.

sources.title: FAQ: stages, African operations requirement and Series A readiness
